package.name: nros_board_zephyr
package.description:
Zephyr board support for nano-ros.
NOTE: this directory holds the board DESCRIPTOR only — the Rust crate implementing this board is the sibling `nros-board-zephyr`. The package.xml must sit beside the descriptor, because that is where `descriptor_path()` looks. The split is pre-existing and inconsistent across the tree (nros-board-nuttx-qemu keeps its descriptor inside the crate); phase-348 W4 has to care, since a descriptor-only package has nothing to build.
phase-348 W2: this file exists so the provider is DISCOVERABLE — the `nano_ros_provides` export below is what a source-time scan reads. What it lowers to is declared in the sibling `nros-board.toml` descriptor, which is read only when this provider is the one selected.
